video_title: Perk Says Yaxel Didn’t Back Down From Luka — And Luka Made Him Pay

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: young players feel they belong and don't show deference
quotes.excerpt: these guys that are coming into the league, they feel like they belong.
quotes.quote: A lot of these young guys, to be honest with you, they don't give a damn. These guys that are coming into the league, AJ Dybantsa is not walking into the room and seeing LeBron James and thinking, 'Oh, bro, let me get a picture.' No, they feel like they belong. They have the, 'Man, fuck you, I'm better than you' attitude. Prime example, two examples that probably nobody ever heard of, but I'm going to tell y'all these stories. Prime example, AJ Dybantsa and Kevin Garnett during a sit-down interview, they get into a heated argument, and literally it's about to go play one-on-one. He's telling Kevin Garnett, 'I will bust your ass.' There's no respect there.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: trash talking is part of the NBA's culture
quotes.excerpt: the NBA is trash talking. The NBA is built on trash talking. We love it.
quotes.quote: I have no issue with it. I think it's good energy, it's a good edge. I think you don't have to show respect. Again, I love Derek Queen, I love the young players. I love Anthony Edwards talking trash to Kevin Durant. I love Kevin Durant talking trash to Giannis Antetokounmpo last night. The NBA is trash talking. The NBA is built on trash talking. We love it. Now, the reason why you typically don't have a rookie talking trash to an all-NBA player, typically why rookies aren't on podiums, but he's a first-round pick, he's a top pick, he's right where he should be.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic teaches lessons by dominating on the court
quotes.excerpt: it's Luka's job to teach him a lesson, not for the rookie to show up and give respect.
quotes.quote: It's Luka's job to teach him a lesson, not for the rookie to show up and give respect. They both did their job. I'm going to show up, I'm not going to give you any respect, because I'm going to treat you like any other person. Luka's job is to take the belt out and teach him what respect is about. And that's what Luka did. And then Draymond backed it up and said, 'Hey, do you know what your job is now, after you took that belt, after we all took that belt? Your job is to see him again, and to keep going back at it.'

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic will respond to trash talk with elite production
quotes.excerpt: if I start chirping to him, he raises his level. Now that might raise your level.
quotes.quote: The respect that he should gain is not so much that, 'Okay, I lost respect with him because of the crying and the whining.' Okay, that's his opinion. The respect you should earn is that, 'Oh, if I start chirping to him, he raises his level.' Now that might raise your level, that's cool. Tim Duncan and Kevin Garnett, Kevin Garnett would say whatever he wanted to Tim Duncan, Tim Duncan would never adjust. Tim Duncan would never eat it. So you've got to learn how to stay within your game, not get a technical as a young player, and then you have to, which I love that he got a technical in his first game, very similar to Draymond. Draymond got a technical on his first basket. I love that.
